title: SQL 窗口函数 (Window Functions)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (12/16)：ROW_NUMBER、RANK、DENSE_RANK、SUM/AVG OVER、LAG、LEAD 与 NTILE

content.content: SELECT user_id, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM orders;
SELECT name, score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk FROM exams;
SELECT name, score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk FROM exams;

content.tips: 每组 Top N 查询
content.content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn FROM products) t WHERE t.rn <= 3;
SELECT id, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS running_total FROM orders;
SELECT id, amount, AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma3 FROM orders;
SELECT id, amount, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS prev_amount FROM orders;
SELECT id, amount, LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS next_amount FROM orders;
SELECT name, score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS quartile FROM exams;
